question: The Resolution of Non-Cooperation movement was confirmed in the annual session of the Indian National Congress at ___________ in December 1920.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. __Nagpur Session__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• C.R. Das moved the main resolution on Non-Cooperation in the annual session of Congress in Nagpur in 1920.
 
• In Nagpur session Congress decided to have the attainment of Swaraj through peaceful and legitimate means, thus committing itself to an extra-constitutional mass struggle.
 
• A program of the surrender of titles, the boycott of schools, courts and councils, the boycott of foreign goods, the promotion maintenance of Hindu-Muslim unity, and strict non-violence was adopted.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi gave up the Kaiser-I-Hind title granted to him by the British government.
 
• A nationwide tour was taken up by Mahatma Gandhi and Ali Brothers of the Khilafat movement, C R Das. Moti Lal Nehru, M.R Jayakar. Saifuddin Kitchlew (Punjab), Vallabhai Patel, C. Rajagopalachari.
 
• T. Prakasam and Asaf Ali left their legal practice and jumped in the full-fledged politics of congress. 
 
• The Non-cooperation movement was the first nationwide mass movement. The year 1921-22 witnessed an unprecedented movement in the nation’s history when there was widespread unrest among students.
 
• A Congress-Khilafat procession took place at Chauri Chaura in the U.P. district of Gorakhpur on February 5, 1922 where 22 police officers were killed by the mob.
 
• Gandhi was profoundly disturbed by the Chauri Chaura incident news.
 
• Gandhi decided to withdraw the movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madras (now Chennai)** was the venue for the annual session of the Indian National Congress in 1927, where the famous Nehru Report was adopted.
 
• **Bhopal,** the capital city of the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh, has never hosted an annual session of the Indian National Congress.
 
• **Surat** was the venue for the annual session of the Indian National Congress in 1907, which witnessed the famous split in the Congress between the moderates and the extremists.
